assign.title: Roles: a Role class, each session records its role, and pages show it

log.msg: show: shots/roles-page-{400,1200,1920}.png, shots/session-role-{400,1200,1920}.png (plan.md) - roles as objects, for the owner approval. Branch worktree/roles-class commit 864650b4a.

findings.text: On a session page the comparison line is drawn as an uppercase h4, "THIS SESSION: CLAUDE-OPUS-5-5 · XHIGH". It reads like a heading, not "this session runs a different model from its role" (content 1, ui) — shots/session-role-1200.png, Models tab, band 2.

A VS Code tab records `role: "vscode mastermind"`, which is not a row in roles.js, so the owner's own tabs (the most common session) show only "Role: vscode mastermind (not a row in roles.js)" and no properties (req 2, "Recording the role") — AISessionDetail.js `show_role`, `Role.find` misses.
Each role card has about two lines of empty space between its name and its first property (spacing) — shots/…-servex-roles/1920.png, every card's top band.

The roles page inherits the Doc's Overview / Tasks / Inbox sub-nav, a second navigation level on a one-screen page that has no tasks or inbox of its own (navigation) — shots/…-servex-roles/1920.png, left column; 400.png, under the tab bar.

Small code notes for the next slice: `Role.agents()`'s comment says "the page's own host first" but the code tries `127.0.0.1:8090` first; core/Role/readme.md links `/Servex/agents/roles.js`, which the site does not serve (the roles page uses `/framework/servex/fs/agents/roles.js`); `Role.from_agent_id` can't tell `assistant` from `page-assistant`, which share the prefix `assistant`.
roles.json is a generated copy of the rows. It is fresh today (`roles-json.mjs --check` exits 0 in worktree/roles-class), but nothing runs `--check` yet, which plan.md admits under "Left".
